// Fixture for audit_test.sh: the correct form of every pattern audit.sh
// checks. The audit must report nothing here. Not compiled.
package repo

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/coregx/relica"
)

type Store struct{ db *relica.DB }

func (s *Store) With(ctx context.Context) relica.Executor { return s.db.WithContext(ctx) }

func transfer(ctx context.Context, db *relica.DB) error {
	tx, err := db.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
	_, err = tx.Update("accounts").
		Set(map[string]any{"balance": relica.NewExp("balance - ?", 10)}).
		Where(relica.Eq("id", 1)).
		Execute()
	if relica.IsUniqueViolation(err) {
		return nil
	}
	return tx.Commit()
}

func queries(ctx context.Context, db *relica.DB) {
	db.Select("id", "t.name AS n", "COUNT(*) AS c").From("t").
		Where(relica.ILike("name", "x")).
		GroupBy("id", "t.name").
		OrderBy("n DESC", "id").
		OrderByExpr("due ASC NULLS LAST").
		All(nil)
	db.Select().SelectExpr("1").From("t").Where(relica.Like("f", "_x")).All(nil)
	db.Select("name").Distinct().From("t").All(nil)
	db.Delete("sessions").
		Where(relica.Eq("user_id", 1)).
		Execute()
	db.Update("settings").Set(map[string]any{"dirty": false}).AllRows().Execute()
	db.Upsert("t", map[string]any{"id": 1, "a": 2}).OnConflict("id").DoUpdate("a").Execute()
	// The action on the next line of the chain, or picked in an if/else.
	db.BatchInsert("t", []string{"id", "a"}).
		OnConflict("id").
		DoUpdateAll().
		Execute()
	batch := db.BatchInsert("t", []string{"id", "a"}).OnConflict("id")
	if keep {
		batch = batch.DoNothing()
	} else {
		batch = batch.DoUpdate("a")
	}
	_ = db.Transactional(ctx, nil)
}

type User struct {
	ID   int    `db:"id"`
	Name string `db:"name"`
	Note string `db:"-"`
}

func (User) TableName() string { return "users" }

type Profile struct {
	ID int `db:"id"`
}

// A named pointer receiver counts as a TableName too.
func (p *Profile) TableName() string { return "profiles" }

func model(db *relica.DB, u *User) { db.Model(u).Insert() }

// Function columns with an alias; a Where with a function is not a select list.
func aliased(db *relica.DB) {
	db.Select("id", "COALESCE(u.full_name, '') AS full_name").From("u").Where("LOWER(name) = ?", "x").All(nil)
	db.Select("id").AndSelect("COUNT(*) as n").From("t").GroupBy("id").All(nil)
}

// Function columns read by position or named by an outer alias: not a struct scan.
func positional(db *relica.DB) {
	var n int
	db.Select("COUNT(*)").From("t").Row(&n)
	var totals []int
	db.Select("COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)").From("t").GroupBy("id").Column(&totals)
	turnover := db.Select("COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)").From("o").Where("o.company_id = c.id")
	db.Select("c.id").SelectSub(turnover.AsExpression(), "turnover").From("c").All(nil)
}

// A table from a variable or a call, with Where or AllRows; a repository's own
// Delete(ctx, id) and Model().Delete() are not UPDATE/DELETE builders.
func varTable(ctx context.Context, db *relica.DB, r *Store, u *User, table string) {
	db.Delete(table).Where(relica.Eq("id", 1)).Execute()
	db.Update(tableName(table)).Set(map[string]any{"a": 1}).AllRows().Execute()
	r.Delete(ctx, 1)
	db.Model(u).Delete()
}

// A comment that quotes a bad chain is not code:
// Danger: db.Delete("t").Execute() would wipe the table.
// Note: a.Union(b).OrderBy("x") sorts the union since v0.20.0.

// Set operations whose OrderBy/Limit keep their meaning: on the first branch
// before Union, inside a branch argument, outside a FromSelect wrapper.
func setOps(db *relica.DB) {
	db.Select("id").From("a").OrderBy("id").Limit(1).Union(db.Select("id").From("b")).All(nil)
	db.Select("id").From("a").Union(db.Select("id").From("b").OrderBy("id").Limit(1)).All(nil)
	db.Select().FromSelect(db.Select("id").From("a").Union(db.Select("id").From("b")), "u").OrderBy("id").All(nil)
}

const dsn = "file:data.db?mode=ro"
